title: Datadog CPU alert flapping on idle pods
symptoms: Datadog CPU utilization monitor fires Alert then OK within 1-5 minutes
PagerDuty pages on-call with no customer impact
Pod CPU usage shows brief spikes during garbage collection or health checks
root_cause: Monitor uses avg(last_1m) threshold without evaluation delay; normal JVM/Go GC spikes trigger false positives
workaround: Acknowledge alert; verify pod is healthy via kubectl top and application health endpoint
permanent_fix: Change query to avg(last_5m) > threshold AND min(count_over_time(...)) >= 3; add recovery threshold hysteresis; tag monitor with owner team

auto_healing.mechanism: Datadog monitor auto-resolve + PagerDuty alert grouping suppresses repeat pages within 15min window

notes: Run analyze_pain_points.py to identify top flapping monitors and map to this KEDB entry
